item.title: Updated Debian 13: 13.1 released
item.description: The Debian project is pleased to announce the first update of its stable distribution Debian 13 (codename trixie). This point release mainly adds corrections for security issues, along with a few adjustments for serious problems. Security advisories have already been published separately and are referenced where available.
